scope: Additive Meteor Staff L1-27 Minion Prince passive strike audit, separating permanent Equipment from temporary Cosmic Rock meteor hazards and Meteor Golem troop.
game_version: Official October 2025 Equipment release; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Cosmic Rock Medal Event!
facts: Meteor Staff is Minion Prince Epic Equipment that summons Meteors during battle to destroy the nearest Defense.
Upgrades increase Meteor strike damage and cadence.
sources.limitations: The page does not define search origin, initial timer, target loss, travel, collision, splash, damage mitigation or exact per-level numbers.

sources.title: Clash-O-Ween Chaos From Above!
facts: An October Hero Challenge explicitly uses Minion Prince Meteor Staff Equipment.
sources.limitations: The challenge is not a source for standard-battle timings or damage.

sources.title: Cosmic Rock Event
facts: Meteor Staff is passive Minion Prince Equipment that repeatedly rains damage on defenses.
sources.limitations: No precise initial delay, cadence phase, hit geometry or current level data.

sources.title: Meteor Staff — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The dated L1-27 Prince HP 558-1381, DPS 13-125 and ore-cost table matches pinned raw fields.
The page says Meteors repeatedly strike the nearest Defense.
sources.limitations: The table omits current strike damage, cooldown and all target/impact mechanics.

sources.title: Pinned Meteor Staff Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned payload has L1-27 cooldownTime 10-5 seconds, damagePerHit 250-850 and Prince HP/DPS bonuses.
sources.limitations: It does not identify first strike phase, attack or impact delay, target geometry, last-target behavior or current effect continuity.

observations.note: All cooldown values are exact multiples of the 10 ms logical tick, but initial phase, impact and retarget order are unsourced.

derivations.result: Retain pinned cooldown, damage and Prince bonuses as catalogue data
derivations.method: Convert pinned second strings to integer milliseconds for audit only; compare Prince HP/DPS and ore fields with the dated client table.

derivations.result: Separate permanent Equipment from event meteors and temporary Meteor Golem
derivations.method: The same official article presents all three as distinct sections; do not import event battlefield hazards or troop behavior into the Equipment.

rejected_inferences.rule: Launch a first Meteor immediately on Prince deployment
rejected_inferences.reason: The source does not specify initial cooldown or launch phase.

rejected_inferences.rule: Select nearest Defense from the Prince center with entity-ID tie-break
rejected_inferences.reason: The official source does not define search origin, range, eligible Defense subclasses or distance metric.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply damage to the target on cooldown tick
rejected_inferences.reason: Meteor travel, impact, collision, splash, target death and mitigation order are undocumented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the event's three random defense-disabling meteors to Meteor Staff
rejected_inferences.reason: The official article describes a separate temporary event gameplay twist.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the event's temporary Meteor Golem and Meteormite as Staff children
rejected_inferences.reason: They are separately offered temporary troops and not stated to spawn from this Equipment.

items: current L1-27 cooldown and damage continuity
first strike, repeated timer reset and Prince death behavior
nearest Defense search origin, radius, category and entity-ID tie resolution
launch, travel, impact, target loss and same-tick damage ordering
splash, footprint overlap, air/ground collision, hit count and mitigation
Prince HP/DPS and other Equipment/Pet interactions
Viewer meteor art/rights and overlay, snapshot, replay and RL state access

conclusion: Meteor Staff L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish passive repeated nearest-Defense strikes, while current effect values and first-strike, targeting and impact timing remain unresolved.
